# SZLHOLDINGS/szl-receiptagent-qwen35-0.8b-v3

This is a separate research bf16 LoRA adapter (r=16, alpha=32) on
`Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B`, trained with Unsloth on a laptop Blackwell GPU, with a derived merged artifact also present in the repository.
"Placeholder" describes release status, not absence of weights. It does not
overwrite [ReceiptAgent v2](https://huggingface.co/SZLHOLDINGS/szl-receiptagent-qwen35-0.8b-v2)
or [SZL-Forge-1.5B-ReceiptAgent](https://huggingface.co/SZLHOLDINGS/SZL-Forge-1.5B-ReceiptAgent).

## Artifact identity and evidence

The [training receipt](https://huggingface.co/SZLHOLDINGS/szl-receiptagent-qwen35-0.8b-v3/blob/fe7564886100316d0843d147abd38da39beb3a4f/training_receipt.laptop-blackwell.json) records
180 training rows and train loss **0.0537**. Training loss is not evaluation.
The receipt describes the local laptop Blackwell bf16 run, not the Rosie
supervised 4-bit lane; `load_in_4bit=false`. Recipe as recorded: bf16 LoRA r=16 α=32, seed 11, 3 epochs, warmup 10, learning rate 1e-4, `held_out_in_gradients=false`, `push_to_hub=false`; hardware NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5050 Laptop GPU (7.96 GB), torch 2.10.0+cu128, Unsloth 2026.7.2, Windows.

The published [development evaluation](https://huggingface.co/SZLHOLDINGS/szl-receiptagent-qwen35-0.8b-v3/blob/fe7564886100316d0843d147abd38da39beb3a4f/eval_dev_named_n.json) records:

| Scope | Recorded result |
|---|---|
| Split and count | DEV, n=12 |
| Total | **11/12** |
| Draft | 4/4 |
| Recovery | **3/4**, one unparseable output |
| Refuse | 4/4 |
| Test split opened | `opened_test_jsonl=false` |

The historical 11/12 failure remains part of the evidence. A separate additive
2026-09-29 owner-run DEV check reports 12/12 on adapter SHA-256
`90b82ade0b2c84eca92e90cdeb56137d61d7da4b4863ff4d29fa75e9dc037870`. It explicitly does not supersede the older record,
records `base_model=UNRECORDED` and `promotion_effect=NONE`, and is not a
held-out test, independent benchmark, release gate, or evaluation of the
derived merged checkpoint. Neither check establishes complete reproducible
inference lineage or deployment readiness.

The [merge receipt](https://huggingface.co/SZLHOLDINGS/szl-receiptagent-qwen35-0.8b-v3/blob/fe7564886100316d0843d147abd38da39beb3a4f/merge_receipt.json) records the 2026-09-14 repair of
an empty base-copy merge (an audit found all 320 tensors byte-equal to the `unsloth/Qwen3.5-0.8B` text tower), applying the root adapter to 96/96 modules with maximum
weight delta 0.0037259478121995926 (`W' = W + (alpha/r)·B@A`, scale 2.0). This repair is artifact construction evidence,
not a fresh behavioral evaluation. No hash of the repaired `model.safetensors` is recorded in that receipt: the merged bytes are PRESENT_UNRECEIPTED by digest.

## Load

Untested in this card pass. Adapter path (the declared artifact):

```python
from peft import PeftModel
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer

base_id = "Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B"
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(base_id)
base = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(base_id)
model = PeftModel.from_pretrained(base, "SZLHOLDINGS/szl-receiptagent-qwen35-0.8b-v3")
```

The root also contains `config.json` and the merged `model.safetensors`; callers must verify which path their library selects rather than relying on loader precedence.
